# Logistics 0.1.2 alpha 10

- Expand Books and Comics reading parity, library navigation, speech, typography, automatic spreads and fold-aware layouts.
- Add a native press-and-hold comic magnifier and improve mobile navigation clearance.
- Sample the image beneath the magnifier's center, preserving blank margins and viewport clamping on iOS and Android.
- Consolidate rclone workflows with transfer review, retry handling, remote browsing and direct readers.
- Keep multiple saved and session-only credential packages side by side, with separate privacy gates and remote identities.
- Improve storage navigation, privacy controls, fullscreen behavior and tablet viewport sizing.
- Validate source-page decoding independently of automatic tablet spreads and isolate mocked native tests from optional mobile packages.

The iOS TestFlight application version is 0.1.6. GitHub publication requires all desktop platform, native mobile and mobile runtime checks to pass. This candidate includes the latest committed commonUtils and Logistics changes and supersedes the earlier unpublished candidates.
